instruction: Increase the text scaling factor to 1.25 in the accessibility settings to make text larger.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires increasing text scaling factor to 1.25 via accessibility settings. Initial config sets text-scaling-factor to 1.0. Agent must navigate settings and change to 1.25. Postconfig closes any opened Settings UI. Evaluator verifies text-scaling-factor equals 1.25 using gsettings command.
metadata.postconfig_purpose: Close Settings UI that may remain open after task completion
